scope: All 210 TAP rows; baseq and augq only; no training.
review_protocol: Fixed blinded text-only semantic classification using only baseq and augq, with the previously manually reviewed 20 TAP pairs preserved as row-level overrides. This is a model-assisted audit, not a substitute for an independent human adjudication.
decision: FAIL_FOR_CLEAN_HELDOUT_TAP: 83.8% SAME_INTENT is below 95%, and one CHANGED_INTENT violates the zero-change rule. Even after retaining only SAME_INTENT TAP rows, only 37 qids have at least two training methods, yielding 109 training positives. Do not use TAP as the proposed clean held-out S family without further human adjudication and broader qid overlap.
